title: Ada-LEval: Evaluating long-context LLMs with length-adaptable benchmarks
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical capabilities of LLMs regarding context length through segment sorting and question-answering tasks (TSort and BestAnswer). While it investigates 'position bias' (the effect of answer location on model performance), it does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
